item.text: I have enough to synthesize: the year improved de-escalation channels and formal security coordination, but the armed environment stayed brittle and proxy-heavy. I’m writing this as a balanced judgment with the main inherited risks and the 2024 deltas called out explicitly.

# Félix Tshisekedi, 2024: 1B.10 research note

## Bottom line
On the evidence available, Tshisekedi left DRC’s existential-risk posture **only marginally safer, and not by much**. The year shows more de-escalation diplomacy and more formal disarmament/security coordination than the start of 2024, but the inherited risk environment remained highly unstable: east Congo fighting persisted, proxy forces were still weakly controlled, and a coup attempt exposed serious security fragility.

## Evidence for a safer posture

- [Programme de désarmement et démobilisation : une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale](https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/) - ACP. `2024-03-22`. The government framed P-DDRCS as a stabilization, peace, and cohesion program to restore state authority where absent. That is meaningful institutional movement toward lowering armed-group risk. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.6`, `1B.4`.

- [Sécurité dans l’Est: le Chef de L’Etat a présidé la deuxième réunion de la Task force du haut commandement militaire](https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/securite_dans_lest_le_chef_de_l_etat_a_preside_la_deuxieme_reunion_de_la_task_force_du_haut_commandement_militaire) - Présidence RDC. `2024-07-09`. Tshisekedi chaired a second interagency military task-force meeting and ordered implementation of measures to preserve territorial integrity. This suggests some increase in centralized crisis management rather than drift. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.3`, `1B.7`.

- [Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu](https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu) - Présidence RDC. `2024-08-12`. Tshisekedi backed the Luanda process, welcomed the ceasefire, and said his government was available for next steps. That is direct evidence of de-escalatory posture. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.1`.

- [Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E. Mr. Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french) - UN Secretary-General. `2024-09-24`. The UN said Tshisekedi discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts. This supports the view that he kept diplomatic channels open in a live crisis. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.1`.

## Evidence for a more dangerous posture

- [Face à la presse, le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC](https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc) - Présidence RDC. `2024-02-23`. Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and force-forward approach to the eastern security problem. That points to a more militarized posture than a clean risk-reduction strategy. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.3`, `1B.7`.

- [Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say](https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/) - Reuters. `2024-07-17`. Reuters reported mismanagement, weak logistics, demoralized troops, and over-reliance on proxies. That is strong evidence the security apparatus remained fragile and partially outside disciplined control. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.6`, `1B.7`, `1B.3`.

- [Democratic Republic of Congo army says it thwarted attempted coup](https://www.tbsnews.net/worldbiz/africa/democratic-republic-congo-army-says-it-stopped-attempted-coup-855206) - Reuters. `2024-05-19`. Armed men attacked the presidency complex and briefly occupied part of the seat of power. This is a serious negative signal for custody and systemic security. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.3`, `1B.8`.

- [Fighting resumes in eastern Congo, army and M23 say](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Fighting-resumes-in-eastern-Congo-army-and-M23-say-48510597/) - Reuters. `2024-12-03`. Reuters reported renewed fighting in violation of the ceasefire, showing the de-escalation framework was not holding by year-end. That weakens any claim that the year clearly left the country safer. Question IDs: `1B.10`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`.

## Search gap

- I found **no direct evidence** on nuclear, bio, cyber, AI, or other catastrophic-risk domains that would let me measure 1B.10 in a literal existential-risk-policy sense.
- For DRC in 2024, the judgment is therefore based on **indirect security and governance signals**: ceasefire diplomacy, disarmament programs, proxy control, military discipline, and crisis fragility.
- The best-supported conclusion is **slight improvement at most, not a decisive shift to safety**.
